mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months indicates severe labor market weakness, triggering anticipatory monetary stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a housing-led demand shift that precedes positive equity market reactions over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (p > 0.05) in regression of 20-day returns, or positive return rate in triggered periods is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation environments (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% YoY), federal funds rate declines signal proactive policy to prevent deflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting regime conditions, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below its 3-month moving average by more than 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, preceding negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE is not significant (p > 0.05), or negative return rate in triggered periods is below 55%.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions (GDPC1 and HOUST above 12-month moving averages), rising consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to trend drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting regime conditions, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 3.0% YoY triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
